name: Create and retain a private note
description: Verifies a signed-in user can create a note and still see it after reopening the vault.
steps: Sign in as Actor A and open the vault
Create a note titled Vault check with the content First saved note
Refresh the page and open All items
expected: Vault check appears once with the saved content still present.

name: Create, validate and edit structured JSON
description: Verifies JSON records reject malformed input and retain valid edits.
steps: Create a JSON item titled Settings
Enter malformed JSON and attempt to save
Replace it with {"theme":"dark","active":true}, save, reopen and edit the theme to light
expected: Malformed JSON is rejected; the valid edited JSON remains saved after reopening.

name: Upload and download an arbitrary file
description: Verifies a real small file can be uploaded, stored in parts and downloaded unchanged.
steps: Choose a small text file named sample.txt containing the text DataNest file test
Wait for the upload to finish and refresh the page
Open the file item and download the original file
expected: The file is marked Saved, and the downloaded sample.txt contains the original text.

name: Keep records isolated between accounts
description: Verifies one account cannot see another account's saved records.
steps: Actor A signs in and creates a note titled Actor A private item
Actor A signs out; Actor B signs in with a different account
Actor B opens All items and searches for Actor A private item
expected: Actor B cannot see Actor A private item.

name: Validate required fields and confirm deletion
description: Verifies invalid data is blocked and confirmed deletion stays deleted.
steps: Open the new note form and try to save it without a title
Create a note titled Remove me
Open it, choose Delete, confirm Delete permanently, then refresh
expected: The empty title is rejected, and Remove me is no longer visible after refresh.
